title: Food Manager Certification
tagline: The manager credential every health inspector expects — proctored, ANSI-accredited, valid for 5 years.
summary: Prepare for the nationally recognized Food Manager exam with modules built around the 2022 FDA Food Code. Includes exam-day proctoring, 90-day retake guarantee, and a reference card learners actually keep on the line.
outcomes: Lead a HACCP-style food safety program for your operation
Train and coach front-line food handlers on safe practices
Pass the ANSI-accredited Certified Food Protection Manager exam
Respond confidently to a health-department inspection

certificate.accepted: All US jurisdictions requiring a Certified Food Protection Manager

faqs.q: Do I need to travel to a testing center?
faqs.a: No. The proctored exam runs in your browser with a webcam. All you need is a quiet room and ID.
